description: Implementation of the IpcModule class for managing IPC channels, including attaching, detaching, and event subscription management within the Rialto client namespace.

classes.name: IpcModule
classes.description: Manages IPC channel lifecycle, event subscriptions, and communication for the Rialto client.

methods.name: IpcModule
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IPC client reference.

methods.name: unsubscribeFromAllEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes from all registered IPC events.

methods.name: attachChannel
methods.description: Attaches to an IPC channel, creating stubs and subscribing to events.

methods.name: detachChannel
methods.description: Detaches from the current IPC channel and unsubscribes from events.

methods.name: reattachChannelIfRequired
methods.description: Reattaches to a new IPC channel if the current one is disconnected.
